title: Finding the equation from a graph

sections.heading: Core Concepts: Finding the equation from a graph

questions.q: For the model $f(x) = 5x + 9$ in finding the equation from a graph, evaluate $f(2)$.
Find the positive solutions to the quadratic equation $x^2 - 6x + 5 = 0$.
A data set recorded for finding the equation from a graph consists of the four values $\{11, 15, 19, 25\}$. What is the arithmetic mean?
questions.answer: The sum is $11 + 15 + 19 + 25 = 70$, and dividing by $4$ gives $17.5$.
